assumptions: The root state name `System` is synthesized because no summary field or explicit controller root name was provided.
`increase` is used as the initial state because it is the first state named in the NL description.

`slp` is modeled as an external continuous slip-error/PID-supervisor input. The wheel-speed, vehicle-speed, slip-ratio computation, PID calculation, and plant dynamics are treated as outside this discrete FSM scope because no executable formula was provided.

M1_guard_off_by_one.description: guard `>= N` mistakenly written as `>= N-1` (fires one cycle too early)

M2_wrong_transition_target.description: transition `A -> B` written as `A -> C` (wrong target state)

M3_unreachable_target.description: guard threshold set far too high (`>= 99999`), target state never reached

M4_missing_forced_transition.description: forced transition `! ...` line missing (global event ignored)

M6_wrong_effect_value.description: effect assigns wrong constant (`var = N` → `var = N+100`)

scenario_results.description: default-init dispatches to increase and applies increase outputs, then default slp=0.0 satisfies increase->hold with hold outputs.
scenario_results.name: default_init_increase_then_hold_at_default_slip

scenario_results.description: explicit-hot-start in increase with slp exactly 0.01 should take increase->hold and neutralize outputs.
scenario_results.name: increase_to_hold_at_upper_boundary

scenario_results.description: explicit-hot-start in increase with slp just above 0.01 should not take increase->hold and should keep increase outputs.
scenario_results.name: increase_no_fire_above_upper_boundary

scenario_results.description: explicit-hot-start in hold with slp greater than 0.01 should take hold->increase and command inlet increase outputs.
scenario_results.name: hold_to_increase_above_upper_boundary

scenario_results.description: explicit-hot-start in hold with slp exactly 0.01 should not satisfy hold->increase and should remain neutral.
scenario_results.name: hold_no_fire_at_positive_boundary

scenario_results.description: explicit-hot-start in hold with slp less than -0.01 should take hold->decrease and command pressure release outputs.
scenario_results.name: hold_to_decrease_below_lower_boundary

scenario_results.description: explicit-hot-start in hold with slp exactly -0.01 should not satisfy hold->decrease and should remain neutral.
scenario_results.name: hold_no_fire_at_negative_boundary

scenario_results.description: explicit-hot-start in decrease with slp exactly -0.01 should take decrease->hold and neutralize valve and pump outputs.
scenario_results.name: decrease_to_hold_at_lower_boundary

scenario_results.description: explicit-hot-start in decrease with slp just below -0.01 should not take decrease->hold and should continue pressure release outputs.
scenario_results.name: decrease_no_fire_below_lower_boundary

evidence: NL: "single-wheel ABS hydraulic regulator as a three-state FSM coupled with a PID-based slip controller"
NL: "Wheel speed and vehicle speed are used to compute the slip ratio, and the PID output drives the Stateflow supervisor"
DSL declares only slp, k1, k2, n and transitions on slp thresholds; no wheel speed, vehicle speed, slip-ratio formula, PID state, or PID gains are represented.
GroundingMap assumption: "wheel-speed, vehicle-speed, slip-ratio computation, PID calculation, and plant dynamics are treated as outside this discrete FSM scope"
findings.summary: The DSL faithfully captures the three-state hydraulic supervisor, valve/pump outputs, and slip-error threshold guards, but it does not model the PID controller or wheel/vehicle-speed slip computation described in the NL.

evidence: inspect_model_to_json_summary.metrics.n_states_leaf = 3
States present: System.increase, System.hold, System.decrease
Actions present: increase sets k1=1,k2=0,n=0; hold sets k1=0,k2=0,n=0; decrease sets k1=0,k2=1,n=500
Transitions present: increase->hold [slp <= 0.01], hold->increase [slp > 0.01], hold->decrease [slp < -0.01], decrease->hold [slp >= -0.01]
findings.summary: Within the discrete FSM scope, the required states, guards, transitions, and output actions are covered.

findings.summary: The model simplifies the coupled ABS controller into a pure threshold supervisor with slp as an external input. This is acceptable as a scoped supervisor candidate but should not be treated as a full ABS hydraulic regulator implementation.
